environment.method: FastAPI TestClient, same seeded account before and after the change
environment.note: Absolute times are from a single constrained development VM and are not comparable to the issue's Docker PostgreSQL 17 host. Compare the before/after deltas and the plan shapes.

dataset.statistics: ANALYZE run on api_usage, runtime_session, managed_agent, flow, flow_execution, ai_model after the bulk load

session_breakdown.before: GroupAggregate over a parallel base sort; external merge Disk 17520 kB + workers 21112 kB + 14024 kB; sort key carried the descriptive title/summary/source/name columns.
session_breakdown.after: Hash joins over an Incremental Sort/GroupAggregate; base external merge Disk 9728 kB + 11592 kB + 6776 kB; sort key is only (ai_model_id, runtime_session_id), so descriptive columns no longer widen the sort.

timeseries.before: GroupAggregate with Sort Method: external merge Disk: 10368 kB.
timeseries.after: HashAggregate with no Sort node; the ORDER BY date_trunc external merge sort is gone.

conclusion.assessment: The query-shape work cut the one-year full-summary warm median by about 41% on the comparison VM and removed the daily timeseries external sort, but the one-year summary is still above the 500 ms warm budget. The conditional daily rollups / response cache from #368 therefore remain justified; this slice does not implement them.
